rationale: The description states an intended call-protection outcome against robocalls and spoofing but does not describe the mechanism or enough conventional functionality to support a firm negative; non_ai is therefore weak and forced.
evidence_spans: Trusted Call Solutions help Communications Service Providers (CSPs) and enterprises take action to protect consumers from the onslaught of robocalls and call spoofing, and get calls answered.
conflict_response: The blind proposal treated the stated call-protection outcome as conventional functionality, but the labeler's concern is material because no mechanism is described. The text has no affirmative AI signal, yet it also does not establish how protection is delivered; I therefore retain non_ai only as a weak forced judgment rather than upgrading it to supported.
